text: Figure 4.11: Modeling of custom service instance [TPS_DEXT_01147] Support for custom service instance ⌈Meta-class Diagnos- ticCustomServiceInstance can be used to define the existence of an instance of a custom diagnostic service.⌋(RS_DEXT_00047) Custom services can obviously not be configured using standardized attributes, but there is the ability to use Sdg in the context of adminData for this purpose. There is no obligation for a given tool to be able to properly process the definition of the custom service instance.
